trust_decision.summary: Whether the redirectUri carried in attacker-controllable external-auth state is a registered redirect URI of the client before the Medplum authorization code is appended and the browser is redirected; decided in externalCallbackHandler via getClientRedirectUri(allowPartial=true), whose raw string-prefix match accepts other hosts/paths.

landing_point.why: The summary names the external auth callback and redirect URI validation; this is the only call with allowPartial=true and carries a comment admitting partial matching.

fix_sites.entry_point: exported getClientRedirectUri(client, uri, allowPartial) — reached by GET /auth/external; also called exact-only from /oauth2/authorize (packages/server/src/oauth/authorize.ts:77) and getStandardClientByRedirectUri (packages/server/src/oauth/clients.ts:42)
fix_sites.module_kind: shared lower-level OAuth client utility (oauth package dir, not auth)

fix_sites.entry_point: same as above (new isAllowedPartialRedirectUri: origin equality + pathname prefix)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver who removes allowPartial at the call site can argue clients.ts is a shared OAuth utility whose partial branch is explicitly documented as legacy back-compat (clients.ts:48-57, :70) and no longer called unsafely; conversely the published fix keeps partial matching behind a project opt-in, so a solver tightening only the handler leaves the opt-in path's prefix check host-unsafe.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Exact-match registered redirect URIs (including deprecated single redirectUri field and standard/default clients from config such as medplum-cli http://localhost:9615) must still receive the code; projects with the opt-in setting must still get same-origin path-prefix matches; the returnTo/allowedPostLoginRedirectUrls fallback and the no-client signin fallback must keep working.

O6_input_shapes: requested URI with extra path appended to a registered URI (redirectUri + '/extra') — fix.diff:322
requested URI extending the registered host (redirectUri + '.evil.com') — fix.diff:366
unparseable URI in partial mode returns false — fix.diff:479-485
registered URI from deprecated redirectUri vs redirectUris array (both merged) — packages/server/src/oauth/clients.ts:84-93

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Medplum web app /oauth page sends the freshly issued code to the redirect_uri query parameter client-side, with no check against the client's registered URIs when the page is opened directly instead of via /oauth2/authorize.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Frontend SPA in another package; normally reached only after server-side /oauth2/authorize validation (packages/server/src/oauth/authorize.ts:77-81, :299-305), and the advisory names only the external auth callback.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (packages/app vs packages/server), 4+ directories away from landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: authorize endpoint calling getClientRedirectUri(..., true) for legacy clients, with error redirects at :89-117 and prompt=none code redirect at :135-138
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same back-compat motive as the external callback comment (external.ts:124-126); a maintainer could have relaxed it for legacy SMART apps.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: getStandardClientByRedirectUri using partial matching for dynamic client registration lookup (oauth/register.ts:17)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MCP/dynamic-registration clients send varying callback paths; prefix matching would be a natural convenience.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: isValidReturnToUrl already uses pathname.startsWith on allowedPostLoginRedirectUrls; a variant comparing raw strings or skipping hostname would be a realistic how-type sibling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same file, same prefix idiom, carries the login id to the target.

O9_family: open redirect / redirect URI validation (OAuth authorization code leakage) — CWE-601/CWE-345

O10_build.project_tests: packages/server/src/auth/external.test.ts (uses mocked node-fetch for IdP, needs Postgres+Redis); packages/server/src/oauth/authorize.test.ts; packages/app/src/OAuthPage.test.tsx

j.j_sites_touched: packages/server/src/auth/external.ts, packages/server/src/oauth/clients.ts (plus regenerated definitions/fhirtypes/docs JSON, non-source)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Drop allowPartial=true at external.ts:127 (exact match only), leaving the prefix-based partial matcher in clients.ts:69 unchanged and breaking legacy projects that rely on partial matching.

out_of_scope_notes: Token endpoint does not bind code exchange to a redirect_uri (no redirect_uri handling in packages/server/src/oauth/token.ts); PKCE in state is attacker-chosen in the external flow (fix.diff:324-325).
